prompt:
Generate exactly FOUR transparent-background pixel-art candidate cells in a 2-column x 2-row atlas. Columns left-to-right: BOTTOM, REAR. Rows top-to-bottom: Personal Space warm wood plank STAIRS UP, then the matching STAIRS DOWN. The local source/current contact shows each precise target row (source plus its six current views); preserve its wood species/color, plank count, frame/stringer design, and up/down rise direction. The separate Ink stair contact is only a geometry diagram: copy no stone pixels or colors.

For each BOTTOM, camera looks straight up along +Z at the complete underside. Show a full horizontal stair-footprint plan with connected warm wood support/stringer bottoms and rear supports; retain the exact footprint and left/right rails. Do not show upper tread tops through opaque wood and do not turn the underside into a generic flat rectangle. For each REAR, camera is level and axis-aligned from the opposite end, showing the solid reverse support/riser construction of the same staircase, not repeating the front-facing top tread cavity. Preserve up/down orientation and original number/spacing of wooden treads. Do not add/remove steps or change pose.

One object per cell, centered with clear transparent margin, full silhouette inside cell; no cell-crossing, no neighbor contamination, no labels/grid/text, no scene/shadow. Crisp dark-outlined pixel art. Source target is sole style/material authority; hidden supports are inferred conservatively.
geometry_guide_role: geometry only; no donor style pixels
qa_notes: rejected: all cells reproduced tread-facing images instead of requested BOTTOM/REAR
